entities.name: Roger François
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roger François was a French weightlifter. He competed at the 1924, 1928 and 1932 Summer Olympics in the middleweight category and finished in sixth, first and fourth place, respectively. François won the world title in 1922 and set seven world records between 1922 and 1928: two in the press, four in the snatch, and one in the total lift. Four of those records were unofficial.
